title: create_experiment with trace_location: a failed link soft-deletes the new experiment and reports the cleanup outcome
answers: create_experiment with trace_location fails and leaves an experiment behind
retry create_experiment with same name after trace location link error fails
mlflow.create_experiment trace_location Unity Catalog link failure cleanup
failed trace location link leaves a deleted experiment whose name is still reserved
body:
Symptom: a user calls mlflow.create_experiment(name, trace_location=...) and the link step fails; the experiment is left behind and retrying with the same name does not work.
Root cause: mlflow/tracking/fluent.py:create_experiment creates the experiment first, then calls _resolve_experiment_to_trace_location; the original except block re-raised without undoing the creation.
Fix pattern: in the except around the link call, call client.delete_experiment(experiment_id) (soft delete). Wrap it in its own try, track success in a flag, and on failure log a WARNING with exc_info=True. Build the re-raised MlflowException message from that flag so it never claims a deletion that did not happen.
Constraints: MlflowClient.delete_experiment is a soft delete and the name stays reserved, so a retry with the same name still fails; this gap is raised in review and not resolved by the PR. Do not describe this as a rollback or as making the name reusable. Permanent removal is via mlflow gc. Applies only to the trace_location branch of create_experiment.
applies: Changes to create_experiment's trace_location path in mlflow/tracking/fluent.py; not general experiment deletion.
says: Creating an experiment with a trace location fails and leaves behind an orphaned experiment.
Retrying experiment creation with the same name fails after a trace location link error.
Clean up newly created experiments when linking to the trace storage location fails.
An experiment creation failure leaves the chosen name reserved and prevents re-creating it.
The error message should accurately report whether deleting the failed experiment succeeded.
search: In mlflow/tracking/fluent.py:create_experiment, if _resolve_experiment_to_trace_location fails during the trace_location branch, the exception handler must call client.delete_experiment(experiment_id) to soft-delete the newly created experiment. The soft delete must be wrapped in its own try block logging a warning on failure, with the re-raised MlflowException indicating whether cleanup succeeded. Because MlflowClient.delete_experiment is a soft delete, the experiment name remains reserved until mlflow gc runs, so retrying creation with the same name will still fail.
